 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Extract upper-left motif (the source contains multiple candidate motifs).
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); c0=min(c for r,c in cells)
    # top-left cluster is separated from the rest by blank gutters
    pts=[(r,c) for r,c in cells if r<8 and c<9]
    a=min(r for r,c in pts);b=max(r for r,c in pts);x=min(c for r,c in pts);y=max(c for r,c in pts)
    return [[grid[r][c] for c in range(x,y+1)] for r in range(a,b+1)]
"
}
